_help: Per-generator overrides for tools/hologram.html, keyed by thumbnail id. hue: degrees (185 cyan, 28 orange). stand: true/false forces a flat model upright (default: auto). yaw0: start angle. fill: fraction of the cell the model fills (default 0.8). skipRender: true leaves the tile on its current art. dark: true renders a black model (opaque near-black body, light rim and edges). sat/light: colour saturation and lightness (sat 0 = white).
